verdict.rationale: The SDK supports LLMs, VLM (vision), STT/TTS/VAD, diarization, and image generation, showing multi-modal breadth, but there is no evidence of MoE architecture support, embedding models, or anything close to 'hundreds' of model architectures — the docs only reference a handful of specific model types/functions. missing for 10: MoE model support, embedding model support, evidence of broad architecture count ('hundreds'), and independent verification of claimed model compatibility beyond a single vendor's engine (MetalRT/llama.cpp fallback).
